_comment: Editorial content for ELCM. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. The company's site is a small legacy WordPress site carrying an About page and a contact page and nothing further, so most fields are null rather than guessed. No image is attached.
description: Elahi Cotton Mills Limited was incorporated as a public limited company on 22 June 1970, with its registered office at Plot No. 270, Sector I-9/3, Industrial Area, Islamabad. The company states that its principal business is the manufacturing and sale of yarn. Its website publishes nothing further about its plant, products or management.
